groups.label: Sign in & onboarding
groups.blurb: Everything before a team is in view: the merged sign-in/sign-up page, the native instance picker, first-run onboarding and invite acceptance.

groups.label: Issues
groups.blurb: The board and the issue itself: list, filters, full detail, comments, creation and cross-board search.

groups.label: My work
groups.blurb: The personal surface: the notification inbox and the assigned-to-me list that shares its route as a tab.

groups.label: Coding
groups.blurb: The Actions surface plus the start-coding launcher and the live steering dock.

groups.label: Reviews
groups.blurb: The cross-board open-PR queue and the read-only diff view behind it.

groups.label: Action authoring
groups.blurb: Editing actions and their automations. Web and desktop only: mobile views and runs actions but never edits them.

groups.label: Support
groups.blurb: The helpdesk thread list and one open conversation.

groups.label: Settings
groups.blurb: One section per real settings route, plus the two condensed native settings screens.

groups.label: Getting started
groups.blurb: The setup checklist: a sidebar sheet on web, a rail screen on desktop.

excludedRoutes.reason: Bare root is a resolver, not a view: it forwards to the last-visited team, the oldest membership, or onboarding.
Static third-party licence notices (EXP-262). Legal text, no product surface worth a shot.
Unconditional redirect to /auth/login since EXP-188. The create-account state is captured as the sign-up view via the openRegister recipe.
Transactional password-recovery form; no product surface, and capturing it needs a live mail sink.
Reachable only through a signed token in a recovery email.
MCP OAuth scope picker; only reachable mid-authorize from a registered OAuth client.
RFC 8628 device-code entry for the CLI daemon; needs a pending device code to render anything.
Declared as the `onboarding` view, but not capturable yet: it needs a signed-in user with NO team and the screenshot seed has none.
Declared as the `invite-accept` view, but not capturable yet: it needs a live unconsumed invite token in the seed.
Anonymous reporter magic-link page; needs a deterministic HMAC token minted per thread.
Legacy redirect into /t/$teamSlug/settings/notifications, kept alive for email verification links.
Team index is a redirect to the last-visited (or first) board; it only paints when the team has zero boards.
Bare settings forwards to the first section the viewer may see.
Cloud-only (CLOUD_INSTANCE=true). Unreachable on the local instance the capturers drive, and the nav item is hidden there.
Global admin console. Operator surface, not a product view; gated by INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAILS.

views.title: Sign in
views.blurb: The merged auth page in its sign-in state: email/password plus whatever OIDC providers the instance advertises.

notes.desktop: Needs a fresh data dir: the IDE restores its session on boot, so there is no dev screen that shows the login pane. Drive it by hand.
notes.ipad: Covered by the iOS styleguide lane; the store lane is signed-in screens only.

views.title: Create an account
views.blurb: The same auth page toggled into its create-account state (EXP-188 merged signup into /auth/login; /auth/register is only a redirect).

notes.ios: Native sign-up is the same form as sign-in with the toggle flipped; not worth a second styleguide shot.
notes.android: Native sign-up is the same form as sign-in with the toggle flipped; not worth a second styleguide shot.
notes.desktop: Same pane as sign-in, toggled. Manual only.

views.title: Instance picker
views.blurb: The pre-login server chooser: cloud or a self-hosted URL. Native only, because the web app IS its instance.

notes.web: Has no web equivalent by construction: the browser already resolved the instance by hostname.
notes.ios: Deferred: it renders before login, so the styleguide suite (which signs in first) cannot reach it. No sg shot yet.
notes.android: Deferred: it renders before login, so the styleguide suite (which signs in first) cannot reach it. No sg shot yet.
notes.desktop: Reachable only from a fresh data dir, same as sign-in. Manual.

views.title: First-run onboarding
views.blurb: Create-or-join: the server-gated wizard every signup lands in before it has a team.

notes.web: Needs the no-team demo user (not seeded yet). Route is /onboarding; declare a web capture once seed-screenshots grows one.
notes.web-mobile: Blocked on the same missing no-team demo user.
notes.ios: Mobile ships the full wizard; a styleguide shot needs a second, team-less demo login.
notes.android: Mobile ships the full wizard; a styleguide shot needs a second, team-less demo login.
notes.desktop: Same gate as web; no dev screen forces it.

views.title: Accept an invite
views.blurb: The invite landing page a teammate opens from an invite link.

notes.web: Route is /invite/$token. Needs a live unconsumed invite in the seed; accepting one burns it, so the capturer has to mint a fresh token per run.
notes.web-mobile: Blocked on the same fresh-token problem.
notes.desktop: Same: needs a per-run token.

views.title: Board
views.blurb: The issue list grouped by status: the app's home screen and the shot everything else is judged against.

views.title: Board filters
views.blurb: The filter popover open over the board: status, assignee, priority and label facets, all URL-backed.

notes.desktop: The drive lands on the board tool; opening the filter menu on top of it is still a manual step (no dev hook for it yet).
notes.ipad: Covered by the iOS styleguide lane.

views.title: Issue detail
views.blurb: One issue in full: markdown description, properties rail, activity, and the live "Coding now" row when a session is running.

views.title: Issue comments
views.blurb: The same issue scrolled to its activity feed: threaded comments, mentions and the composer.

notes.desktop: Same screen as issue-detail; the scroll to the activity feed is manual.
notes.ipad: Covered by the iOS styleguide lane.

views.title: New issue
views.blurb: The create-issue dialog with its title/description editor and the inline property pickers.

notes.desktop: Reached from the board tool's composer; no dev screen opens the dialog directly.
notes.ipad: Covered by the iOS styleguide lane.

views.title: Search
views.blurb: Cross-board issue search with live results as you type.

notes.desktop: Command-palette style overlay; no dev screen opens it.
notes.ipad: Covered by the iOS styleguide lane.

views.title: Inbox
views.blurb: The notification stream: assignments, mentions, comments and PR events, grouped and unread-first.

views.title: My issues
views.blurb: Everything assigned to me across every board in the team. A tab on the inbox route, not a route of its own.

notes.desktop: The Inbox tool window's My Issues tab (ToolWindow::Inbox + InboxTab::MyIssues), one rail entry with the board tool.
notes.ipad: Covered by the iOS styleguide lane.

views.title: Actions
views.blurb: The team's action catalog plus the machines that can run it: the Agents page, one card per action.

notes.ipad: Covered by the iOS styleguide lane; the store lane uses actions-mobile instead.

views.title: Actions (mobile)
views.blurb: The phone-shaped Actions surface: the pushed detail view mobile reaches from Agents, with the run affordance per card.

notes.web: Desktop viewports render the same panel inline on the Agents page: capture `agents` instead. /t/$teamSlug/agents/actions exists purely as the mobile detail route (EXP-574).
notes.desktop: See `agents`: the desktop Actions screen is the web Agents page 1:1.

views.title: Start coding
views.blurb: The launcher: pick the machine, the agent and the options, then hand the issue to a coding session.

notes.desktop: The desktop dialog is the real launcher, not a remote-start picker: capturing it needs a live repo clone and a doctor-clean agent. Manual for now.

views.title: Steering a session
views.blurb: The agent dock mid-run: scrubbed activity feed, the agent's open question, and the reply box that answers it.

notes.web: Needs `bun run screenshots:desktop` running: the feed is relay-fed, and an unreachable relay photographs a Reconnecting state instead. The anchor is the tail fragment of DEMO_FEED_QUESTION in apps/web/scripts/screenshot-demo.ts.
notes.desktop: The owning desktop app IS the session host; there is no dock to open on it. Capturing the host-side terminal view needs a live run. Manual.

views.title: Reviews
views.blurb: Every open PR across the team, issue-linked ones grouped by board, each with a one-click squash merge.

notes.ipad: Covered by the iOS styleguide lane; the store lane uses review-diff.

views.title: Review diff
views.blurb: A PR's real diff, side by side, with the first file expanded. APP-14 fetches a genuine patch from GitHub.

notes.web: The diff is fetched live from GitHub, so this view is the slowest in the catalog and the most network-flaky. Keep the generous anchor timeout.

views.title: Action editor
views.blurb: One action's definition: name, icon, the markdown body the agent runs, its repo and its typed inputs.

notes.web-mobile: Editing is web/desktop only (EXP-257); mobile views and runs actions but never edits them.
notes.desktop: Owner-gated dialog on the Actions screen; opening it needs an owner session and an existing action row. Manual.

views.title: Automation editor
views.blurb: Binding an action to a device and a trigger: the schedule-or-event when-part behind the Automations tab.

notes.web-mobile: All four clients have an Automations tab, but the editor shot is web/desktop only for now.
notes.ios: All four clients have an Automations tab, but the editor shot is web/desktop only for now.
notes.android: All four clients have an Automations tab, but the editor shot is web/desktop only for now.
notes.desktop: Owner-gated dialog on the Actions screen. Manual.

views.title: Support inbox
views.blurb: The helpdesk queue: every reporter thread with its snippet, open conversation in the right pane.

notes.web: Requires teams.helpdesk_enabled on the demo team; the rail/nav entry hides entirely when it is off.

views.title: Support thread
views.blurb: One conversation end to end: the reporter's messages, the team's replies, and the escalate-to-issue action.

anchor.text: thank you for the quick turnaround

notes.desktop: Support data is server-only tRPC, so the thread id placeholder has to be resolved by the capturer at run time.
notes.ipad: Covered by the iOS styleguide lane.

views.title: Getting started
views.blurb: The setup checklist: connect a repo, install the desktop app or CLI, wire MCP, drop in the widget.

notes.web: Not a route: it is a sidebar-footer sheet (EXP-88), and the button hides once every checklist entry is done (EXP-548). The seed must leave at least one entry incomplete or the recipe has nothing to click. The same cards also render inline under an EMPTY board's empty state.
notes.web-mobile: The phone layout replaces the sidebar with the tab bar, and the footer entry with it — there is no mobile entry point for the sheet.
notes.ios: Mobile has no checklist surface yet.
notes.android: Mobile has no checklist surface yet.
